description: This file defines the 'Translation' controller class within the Opencart admin module, handling translation management including listing, editing, enabling/disabling, deleting, and retrieving translation data via AJAX.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Controller class for managing translations in the admin panel, including CRUD operations and AJAX endpoints.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the translation list page, setting up data and rendering the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares translation data for listing, including pagination and filtering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a translation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing translation via POST request.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Retrieves language file paths for a given language ID.

methods.name: translation
methods.description: Fetches translation entries for a specific store, language, and route.
